title: ai-pattern-mining-outline
summary: A personal repository of clustered code snippets apparently extracted from various open-source projects for pattern-mining or research purposes, including classes copied from the sdgx synthetic-data-generator project that wrap copulas.multivariate.GaussianMultivariate and implement a CTGAN-style synthesizer. The SDV-family copulas package is referenced only inside this vendored third-party sdgx code, not called directly by the repository's own logic.
needs: No README; unclear if this is genuine authored work or scratch output from code clustering across unrelated repos (sdgx, not sdv itself, is the direct source of the copulas usage).
